generated.what_happened: Canadian poet, essayist, classicist, and translator Anne Carson has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature. The Swedish Academy recognized the 76-year-old author for her bold and inventive oeuvre that creates new forms for contemporary literature through playful dialogue with the classical tradition. Carson's eclectic body of work includes notable titles such as Autobiography of Red, The Beauty of the Husband, and Eros the Bittersweet. In addition to her literary accomplishments, she has worked as a professor teaching classics, translation, and artistic collaboration.
